issues.description: Grouping column mismatch between the problem statement and the provided solution for Aufgabe 04: the problem (problem_statement.md) requires sums grouped by the Regierungsbezirk ("regierungsbezirk") and to output the name of the Regierungsbezirk. The solution (solution_repository/aufgabe04.sql) selects regierungsbezirk in the SELECT list but uses GROUP BY kreis. Selecting regierungsbezirk while grouping by a different column (kreis) is inconsistent and will cause incorrect or invalid SQL in strict SQL dialects and will confuse students about which column they must group by.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the grouping consistent with the problem statement. Either group by regierungsbezirk to match the SELECT and the task: e.g. "SELECT regierungsbezirk, SUM(einwohner_w), SUM(einwohner_m) FROM Gemeinde GROUP BY regierungsbezirk"; or, if the intention was to group by kreis, change the SELECT and the problem text to return kreis (and its aggregates) instead. Prefer updating solution_repository/aufgabe04.sql to use GROUP BY regierungsbezirk to match the problem statement.
